analysis.headline: Shares Your Data Broadly
analysis.quote: If you do not opt out, in some instances the recipients of the information may use it for their own independent purposes in addition to those stated in X’s Privacy Policy, including, for example, to train their artificial intelligence models, whether generative or otherwise.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Biometric Data
analysis.quote: Based on your consent, we may collect and use your biometric information for safety, security, and identification purposes.

analysis.headline: Trains AI with Your Content
analysis.quote: We may use the information we collect and publicly available information to help train our machine learning or artificial intelligence models for the purposes outlined in this policy.

analysis.headline: Infers Your Identity
analysis.quote: We may collect or receive information that we use to infer your identity as detailed below: When you access X and are not signed in, we may infer your identity based on the information we collect.

analysis.headline: Tracks Your Devices
analysis.quote: Subject to your settings, we may also associate your account with browsers or devices other than those you use to sign into X (or associate your signed-out device or browser with other browsers or devices or X-generated identiﬁers).

analysis.headline: Scans Your Direct Messages
analysis.quote: We collect information about...when you use Direct Messages, including the contents of the messages, the recipients, and date and time of messages.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Precise Location
analysis.quote: You can also choose to share your current precise location or places where you’ve previously used X by enabling these settings in your account.

analysis.headline: Retains Your Data Indefinitely
analysis.quote: Where you violate our Rules and your account is suspended, we may keep the identifiers you used to create the account (such as your email address or phone number) indefinitely to prevent repeat policy offenders from creating new accounts.

analysis.headline: Limits Data Portability
analysis.quote: We may, in certain situations, reject your request for access, correction, or portability, for example, we may reject access where you are unable to verify your identity.
